_what: ⛔ THREE CENSUSES THAT WERE LIVING IN CCODE'S TEST FILE AND ARE AEVI'S TO RULE. Each one records a decision about CONTENT — which names are deliberately left unbound, which fen pairs are a known collision, and the bearings Aevi measured by hand as the specification — and each one used to be a literal inside `tests/content_ci.mjs` or `tests/how_it_works.mjs`. So every content ruling of hers waited on an edit to a test file of his.
_why: ⛑ CCODE-602 SET THE PATTERN AND AEVI ASKED FOR IT AGAIN BY NAME (SNG-676): *"Three of these six are censuses that wait on my rulings. If they lived in content with a ratifications list, the way ratified_census.json does, my next split call wouldn't wait on your test file."* She is right, and it is the same finding CCode logged after the tier census: a ratified number belongs with the content it counts, not in the gate that reads it. ⚠️ THE GATES LOSE NO TEETH — an ACCIDENTAL unbound name or an unexpected collision still reds, because the only way to pass is a deliberate edit here recording what was decided and why.
_howToChange: Add or remove a row AND add a line to `ratifications`. A row with no ratification is a number nobody decided.
